phrase: a Skin and Hair Supplements Brand
verdict: Yes. Beautywise pitched science-backed skin and hair supplements on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Beauty-from-within is one of the fastest-growing supplement segments, especially collagen, biotin and gummies, but results take weeks and buyers need patience.
angle: Buyers want better skin and hair and are willing to take supplements alongside skincare. Gummies and flavoured powders make daily use easier. Dermatologists and beauty creators influence buyers most. Set realistic expectations about results to avoid bad reviews.
